result:
All five reports are fixed in four source files. The typecheck and lint are clean, and the full suite passes (73 files, 617 tests).

- **Comment count (1):** `countComments` in `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts` now excludes deleted comments. Replies are still counted.
- **Deleting a comment (2):** the `comment.deleted` handler in `src/server/services/search-service.ts` was removing the document under kind `"issue"`. It now removes kind `"comment"`, so only that comment goes.
- **Archiving an issue (3):** the `issue.archived` handler also deletes every comment document under that issue, in one statement scoped to the org and issue (`deleteCommentDocumentsForIssue` in `src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts`).
- **Rebuild (4):** `src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts` now reads only live projects and non-archived issues, and only non-deleted comments (replies at any depth, including a live reply to a deleted parent). After a clean run it prunes any document it did not re-upsert, so the index matches the live content. It is skipped if any item failed. Re-running it does not change the count.
- **Backlog (5):** projects, issues and comments are walked to the last page via `nextCursor`, instead of only the first 100 rows.

I also made the event handlers that index a re-read row skip it if it is no longer live (`issue.created`, `issue.updated`, `comment.created`, `search.reindex_requested`). This stops a comment deleted just after creation from being re-indexed.

I checked all five scenarios with a temporary test file, which I removed afterwards.

Not addressed: archiving a project with `archiveIssues` cascades to its issues without emitting per-issue events, so those issues and their comments stay searchable until the next rebuild.
